newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo in $70 mln Romania joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo in $70 mln Romania joint venture.

text.p: The construction division of South Korea's Daewoo Corp has entered into a joint venture with a Romanian real estate developer to construct and develop five projects worth $70.4 million, the company said on Monday.
A Daewoo statement said the venture, known as Daewoo-Sitraco Construction SRL, was capitalised at $14 million on a 50:50 basis.

The venture will begin construction of the luxury apartments, offices and commercial building projects in Bucharest from February, 1997. The projects are expected to be completed by the beginning of the year 2000.
